name: Toymaker: Threads of Joy
storyline:
Craft a narrative filled with mystery and magical legends as you uncover the mythology of Salamanca, our hometown and the place your mother once called home. Inspired by the folk tale “The Cave of Salamanca”, where a mysterious man secretly taught magic to his students in an underground cavern, the story blends reality and myth in a world shaped by your choices.

In Toymaker: Threads of joy you will discover different locations from the 1910s Salamanca, Spain. Players will have to interact with important historical Spanish figures like the writer Miguel de Unamuno and shape the lives of your customers, neighbors from your own town.

Engage with ancient gods, confront the memories tied to your mother, and make each stitch count as it influences not only your own path but also the destiny of the city and the people who inhabit it.
summary: Toymaker is a toy-crafting and store management simulator set in the 1910s Spain. Meet unique customers and colorful locals in a bustling city, and discover a magical story based on a folk legend. Follow two different mythic paths, and change the future of your hometown!
